repos.setupCommand: MAIN=$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)"); if [ -f "$MAIN/.worktreeinclude" ]; then git -C "$MAIN" ls-files -z --others --ignored --exclude-from="$MAIN/.worktreeinclude" | tar -C "$MAIN" --null -T - -cf - | tar -xf -; else echo 'No .worktreeinclude found - skipping file copy'; fi
